svg.aria-label: Airflow ELT Warehouse: Orchestrated ELT from raw operational data to a PostgreSQL star schema. Pipeline: extract → load → SQL models → quality gate. 3 dimensions + 1 fact table built by dependency-ordered, dbt-style SQL models Final DAG task runs not-null, unique, range and referential-integrity checks, and fails the run on any violation Source data deliberately contains invalid rows, so the gate is tested against real failures Stack: Airflow · Postgresql · Sql · Docker Compose · 7 Tests.
